properties.name: bpmnProcessId
properties.description: ID of the process element within the BPMN XML.

properties.name: bpmnXml
properties.description: Model of the BPMN process as XML.

items.description: ErrorDefinition is used to define an error event.

properties.name: bpmnElementId
properties.description: Element ID of the error event within the BPMN XML.

items.description: EscalationDefinition is used to define an escalation event.

properties.name: bpmnElementId
properties.description: Element ID of the escalation event within the BPMN XML.

items.description: MessageDefinition is used to define a message event.

properties.name: bpmnElementId
properties.description: Element ID of the message event within the BPMN XML.

properties.name: parallelism
properties.description: Maximum number of parallel process instances being executed. If 0, the number of parallel process instances is unlimited.

items.description: SignalDefinition is used to define a signal event.

properties.name: bpmnElementId
properties.description: Element ID of the signal event within the BPMN XML.

items.description: Tag is used to tag processes, process instances and user tasks.
TimerDefinition is used to define a timer event.

properties.name: bpmnElementId
properties.description: Element ID of the timer event within the BPMN XML.

properties.name: timer
properties.description: A timer defines a point in time using a time value, a CRON expression or a duration.

properties.name: timeCycle
properties.description: CRON expression that specifies a cyclic timer.

properties.name: timeDuration
properties.description: Duration based timer that uses the engine's time to calculate a point in time.

properties.name: workerId
properties.description: ID of the worker that created the process.
